title: Initial configuration code test
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, Boolean input word $x$, and natural numbers $S,c$, the Boolean indicator of the initialization language, evaluated on the encoding of $x$ together with the binary representations of $c$ and $S$, equals true exactly when $c$ is the code of the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ using window size $S$.
